_doc: Backtest over real Sharadar data. NOT a Gate G1 attempt: the current Sharadar subscription is free-tier (the ~30 Dow constituents, ~5 years of history, no ETFs), so the cross-sectional momentum percentile is computed over a handful of mega-caps, eleven of which the over-optioned rule excludes. It exists to run the real pipeline on real market data. See docs/DECISIONS.md, 'Vendor entitlements'.
_start_date_doc: Stock history begins 2021-09-16 on this tier; the 252-session momentum lookback needs a year of warm-up before the first evaluated session.

walk_forward._folds_doc: Two 1-year folds, not the designed three 2-year folds: only ~4 usable years exist on this tier. A real G1 run uses the config/backtest.*.json produced from a full subscription.
